description: This file implements the core synchronization logic for the Notesnook application, including managing WebSocket connections, handling sync data transfer, merging incoming data, and orchestrating sync operations.

classes.name: SyncManager
classes.description: Manages overall synchronization process, including starting, stopping, and locking sync operations.

classes.name: Sync
classes.description: Handles detailed sync operations such as establishing connections, data transfer, merging, and error handling.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the sync process based on provided options, including fetching and sending data.

methods.name: acquireLock
methods.description: Runs a callback within a lock to prevent concurrent sync operations.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing sync process and performs cleanup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the device for sync, registering if necessary.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches data from the server and updates local state.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Uploads local changes to the server.

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Processes incoming data chunks, decrypts, deserializes, and merges them.

methods.name: pushItem
methods.description: Pushes a single item to the server.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for real-time sync.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Ensures the WebSocket connection is active, reconnecting if necessary.
